sectionHeader.title: Curated Neighborhood Guides
sectionHeader.description: Discover the lifestyle nuances, architectural heritage, and market dynamics across the world's most desirable residential enclaves.

neighborhoods.name: Beverly Hills & Bel Air
neighborhoods.tagline: Iconic heritage estates and lush canyon privacy
neighborhoods.description: Synonymous with global prestige, offering secluded hillside compounds, world-class private dining on Rodeo Drive, and historic mid-century architectural legacies.

neighborhoods.name: Aspen & Snowmass
neighborhoods.tagline: High-alpine majesty meets four-season cultural vibrancy
neighborhoods.description: An internationally celebrated alpine enclave combining premier ski-in/ski-out estates, world-class music and ideas festivals, and year-round mountain retreats.

neighborhoods.name: Tribeca & SoHo
neighborhoods.tagline: Historic cobblestone charm and soaring loft volumes
neighborhoods.description: New York's preeminent downtown addresses, characterized by authentic cast-iron façades, Michelin-starred bistros, designer boutiques, and rooftop penthouses.

neighborhoods.name: Miami Beach & Star Island
neighborhoods.tagline: Tropical modernism, private docks, and turquoise horizons
neighborhoods.description: A sun-drenched sanctuary of ultra-contemporary waterfront villas, deep-water mega-yacht moorings, and effortless access to international art and nightlife.

areaGuidePromo.title: Request Bespoke Neighborhood Dossiers
areaGuidePromo.description: Receive comprehensive private market reports, school district ratings, zoning insights, and recent off-market comps.
